boundary: Repository-scoped sanitized memory only; it grants no identity continuity or authority.
portable_guards: Do not repeat the same short wrapper; preserve every timeout and verify EOF content before task action.
Never embed an unquoted upstream hashtable-like expression in a PowerShell revision range.
Probe utility availability once, then select the built-in parser and retain the missing-tool event.
Require zero inherited and zero within-current exact collisions before generating phase artifacts.
Forward-test every literal scanner needle against its own source before staged review credit.
Use exact case only for case-significant syntax; use Unicode casefold for natural-language reservation phrases.
Before aggregate reruns, compare authoritative failure count, derived total, and Method Flow fail and pass witness counts.
Give each potentially slow Windows repository probe its own process, timeout, and receipt; never infer success from a timed aggregate wrapper.
Discover files with rg --files and filter them, or inspect an exact file with LiteralPath.
Preflight required CLI options and always include an evidence-bounded promotion note.
Resolve the exact artifact path, use ErrorActionPreference Stop, and fail if any required field is null.
Pin UTF-8 in the child-process environment before launch; never delete or transliterate culturally correct text to satisfy a locale-dependent console.
Bind named test loading to the exact repository root before constructing the unittest suite.
Never infer a passing runner from file existence; parse the declared success field and fail closed on malformed or absent receipts.
Include sanitized test identifiers, not private traces or paths, in every failed bounded-test receipt.
Evaluate historical x1 cardinalities from the frozen x1 commit object; use the current tree only for append-only lifecycle checks.
Use an exact wrapper filename set rather than a broad scripts prefix, preserving rejection of unrelated sibling or historical files.
Require exactly one terminating newline and no extra blank line in generated or patched source files.
